Description

Parse stable tmux releases and check the supported release range.

These functions consume supplied text. They neither execute tmux -V nor contact a server. Admission checks the inclusive 3.3a through 3.8 range; individual features still need capability and conformance checks.

Use parseVersion for input, requireSupported for supported-range admission and renderVersion for canonical output.

>>> :set -XOverloadedStrings
>>> fmap renderVersion (parseVersion "tmux 3.3a\n" >>= requireSupported)
Right "3.3a"

Parse and render

parseVersion :: Text -> Either VersionError TmuxVersion Source #

Parse a stable release or the output of tmux -V, allowing one final LF. Development builds and trailing data are rejected rather than assigned capabilities from a guessed stable version. Diagnostics retain at most 64 chars.

renderVersion :: TmuxVersion -> Text Source #

Render the canonical release without the executable name or newline.

Admit a release

requireSupported :: TmuxVersion -> Either VersionError TmuxVersion Source #

Admit every stable release from 3.3a through 3.8, including intermediate releases. Versions outside that range fail. Individual features need their own capability checks; passing this check does not qualify an entire release.
